aiModel.subtitle: Fine-Tuned Language Model | Hugging Face: laravelcompany/laravelmail
aiModel.description: Built and deployed a production-ready fine-tuned LLM for financial communications:
highlights: Base model: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct — selected for efficient inference on commodity hardware
Fine-tuning framework: Unsloth — achieved 2× faster training compared to standard approaches
Quantization: GGUF Q4_K_M format — reduced memory footprint while preserving instruction-following capability
Deployment: Ollama with custom Modelfile — enables local, privacy-preserving inference
Adoption: 100+ downloads in first month — demonstrates real-world utility
